about.heading: About & Philosophy
about.sub: Bridging quantitative engineering and statutory analysis.
about.body1: I am Arya Rifki (online handle: sugarate), an independent developer and undergraduate law student based in Semarang, Indonesia. I spend my days turning unstructured, messy public feeds into clean, reproducible data pipelines that enable confident decision-making.
about.body2: My work sits at the rare convergence of data engineering, Indonesian capital markets (IDX), and legal informatics. I believe that whether evaluating market depth or analyzing judicial rulings, conclusions must be grounded in verified data rather than speculation.
